title.en: Efforts to Improve Financial Independence of Public Hospitals: Recommendations for Policy Improvement
title.id: Efforts to Improve Financial Independence of Public Hospitals: Recommendations for Policy Improvement

description.en: Working with Bappenas, CHAMPS studied public hospital financing and developed a roadmap for greater financial autonomy and sustainable service delivery.
description.id: Bersama Bappenas, CHAMPS mengkaji pembiayaan rumah sakit pemerintah dan menyusun peta jalan untuk kemandirian keuangan serta layanan yang berkelanjutan.
